basic_info.title: America's New Material Could END POTHOLES Forever!
basic_info.short_description: America's roads are falling apart, and the reason comes down to a recipe that has barely changed since 1870. Almost 95% of the 2.8 million miles of paved road in the United States are covered in asphalt, a mix of rock, sand, and gravel held together by about 5% bitumen, a sticky leftover from oil refining. In 2021 alone, 1 in 10 American drivers paid an average of $600 to fix pothole damage, adding up to $26.5 billion in a single year.
